description: Makes agents in parallel threads take turns on builds and tests, and shows each thread its queued runs. Threads on a machine with drmanhattan, a local job queue, are told to run heavy commands through it, so several agents stop compiling at the same time and slowing each other down. While a thread has runs going, a row above its composer shows each run's slot or place in line against its usual time, with a cancel button and a link to its log; the Info tab lists recent results. Agents and scripts also get bb drmanhattan runs, status and cancel. Needs the free, open-source drmanhattan command-line tool installed and running on each machine (macOS or Linux).
